host.description: IP address or hostname the service should bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port number for the APY service to listen on.

workers.description: Number of worker processes (0 = auto-detect based on CPU cores). Set to 1 for development/testing.

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests a worker handles before being restarted (prevents memory leaks).

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Increase for complex translations or large text inputs.

log_file.description: Path to log file; empty string means log to standard output.

pid_file.description: Path to store the process ID file (used by init systems for service control).

langpairs.description: List of language pairs (e.g., ['eng-spa', 'fra-deu']) to expose. If empty, all installed pairs are exposed.

items.description: A language pair in the format 'src-trg', e.g., 'eng-spa'.

whitelist.description: Optional list of language pairs to whitelist (overrides langpairs). Empty means no restriction.

items.description: Allowed language pair in 'src-trg' format, e.g., 'eng-spa'.

preload.description: Whether to pre-load translation models at service startup (improves first-request latency).

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (in MB) allowed per worker process. Workers exceeding this will be restarted.

keepalive.description: Enable HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connections for improved performance.

path.description: Base URL path for API endpoints (e.g., '/translator' → /translator/listPairs).

cors.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers for browser-based clients.

server_header.description: Optional custom value for the HTTP 'Server' response header (e.g., 'Apertium-APY/3.7'). Leave empty to use default.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass directly to the apertium-apy binary (e.g., '--mode server').
